en: A monochrome illustrated industrial scene showing a large multi‑storey brewery complex with tall chimneys emitting smoke, surrounded by smaller buildings, streets, and a waterfront with sailing ships and steam vessels. The illustration is framed with a wide white border. Below the image, printed text identifies the establishment as D. Carnegie & Co Ltd, brewers in Gothenburg, Sweden.
